notes.title: Developers update 24
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twenty-fourth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

We have been silent lately, however, we weren’t turning our thumbs, in fact the game has progressed tremendously over the past few weeks. The reason for our silence is, that we have been moving to a new and larger office. During development of Call to Arms, our team has grown steadily and it was time to do the next step. Needless to say, that we wanted to accomplish this without adding any further delays to the game, so our focus has been on a smooth transition and we are happy to let you know that we succeeded in doing so. :cta_emo1:

So what have we been working on in the meantime?


[h1]Improved 3rd person controls[/h1]
We spent a lot of time on improving the 3rd and 1st person controls in-game. Better animations, better controls, better heightmap interaction for easier and more accurate movement. Currently we are working on squad movement orders via 3rd person and hit direction indicators, as well as a recoil system to make shooting much more of a skilled experience.


[h1]Sounds[/h1]
The sound environment of battles has been completely reworked. Weapons differ if you are shooting in close or far distance, that leads to a much more natural sound environment. This was necessary to make the 3rd and 1st person experience closer to reality and this added a much better overall experience.


[h1]New factions[/h1]
The new factions are also shaping up very well and soon after release of the game, we should be able to deliver you the first content pack with lots of exciting new equipment and units. Can you guess which tanks you can see on the screenshots?

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_102b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_102.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_103b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_103.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Map pack[/h1]
We are also working on a multiplayer map pack, we expect it to be done by the end of next month. Furthermore, the singleplayer campaign is receiving extra work and polish to make it more interesting and challenging to play.


[h1]Helicopters[/h1]
We think, the screenshot is speaking for itself! :cta_emo10:

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_104b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_104.jpg[/img][/url]

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Developers update 23
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_10.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twenty-third developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

The development is in full swing and we are progressing very well. We have reached the last quarter of the development and the game release is in sight. We have set up internal milestones in support of the release preparations. This means, we are clearly prioritizing each task to finish the game in a timely manner without making any compromises on the quality we want to achieve.

While the programming team is currently focusing on the 3rd and 1st person mechanics and soon on the new in-game UI. Our team of artists is already working on the new factions to reduce the waiting time after release!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_98.jpg[/img] 
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_99.jpg[/img]

For 3rd and 1st person, we are working on a multitude of changes. We just introduced high quality 1st person human hand models and different damage depending on body areas, as a next step we will be working on improving the animations. Further improvements will include weapon blow back effects, breathing mechanics, slow walking in zoom, new scopes, hit direction feedback, commanding squad members in 3rd person and many more features that improve the whole ground battle experience!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_100.jpg[/img] 


Scopes and sights vary on the type of weapon you are using now. If you are controlling a soldier, a decent vignette effect will also highlight the more accurate aiming and slower walk speed.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_101.jpg[/img] 



[h1]Some humble words[/h1]
First of all, we are very grateful for the support we have received over the many months since we started the development of Call to Arms. The feedback has been extremely valuable to us and we are excited to see how the game is finally shaping up and is becoming a new and fun experience for everyone. Unfortunately, we still have this regular amount of reviewers complaining about the free version, microtransactions, Season Pass without playing the game at all, or reading the available information about these issues. Therefore, we would like to address this once and for all: the purchased editions of the game did not turn into a free game. The game is still up for sale. Maybe the time of demos is so far away by now, that some forgot that it’s actually a good thing if you can try a game out before buying.

Are we milking customers? No, we are adjusting ourselves to the reality we all live in. A reality in which the grand majority of developers are struggling with the flood of games on all platforms, with exploding marketing and development costs and with completely oversaturated markets. A reality in which last year almost 1000 people lost their jobs in the German games industry alone, while we were still hiring people and paying our team on time. If we don’t learn to adjust ourselves, then we will be just another name on a very long and sad list of studios. Sometimes this means radical changes, as we have seen with Call to Arms lately. However, these radical changes increased the player counts by 5 times and increased our profits to a level where we can continue to dedicate all of our resources to the game, which ultimately results in a much better game for everyone.

You can be with or against change, but you can only decide between more and better games of that type with a different business model or no further type of these games at all. So, let us work together on making this a success story for many years to come and focus on what is important: a great game!

Further improvements will include weapon blow back effects, breathing mechanics, slow walking in zoom, new scopes, hit direction feedback, commanding squad members in 3rd person and many more features that improve the whole ground battle experience!

notes.title: Developers update 22
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twenty-second developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Hardcore Mode[/h1]
We will be introducing a hardcore game setting created for fast and deadly combat. While we wish to design the base game as a good mix between tactics and action, we still understand that a lot of people would also enjoy a more realistic approach to combat. Hardcore mode will deliver what you are looking for and mistakes will be punished mercilessly.


[h1]Hit Zones[/h1]
Furthermore, we will introduce body hit zones for humans, so if you hit a leg or arm, it will do less damage than a body hit and of course headshot. This will add an additional level of skill required to win battles in 3rd person mode against other humans!


[h1]Damage Indicators[/h1]
We introduced some visual feedback to let players know when a soldier is on low health, in the future we will also implement damage indicators that help you to understand where enemy fire is coming from. This will be useful for soldiers and vehicles.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_87b.jpg[/img]


[h1]Improved Aiming[/h1]
The responsiveness of 3rd person human controls have been improved drastically and more changes are to come. You will be able to enjoy the new mechanics in the next update already! Moreover camera controls have been improved and add additional polish to your 3rd person experience.


[h1]Squad Controls[/h1]
In case your soldier dies, the game will auto select the next squad member, so that you are not losing any time to counter your enemy. On long term, we want you to be able to command your squad members to cover. Hopefully we will be able to prototype the feature early next year. It should enhance 3rd person squad controls drastically :cta_emo1:



If you didn't do so yet, contribute your gameplay video to win a Season Pass!
steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/599372911099903657

http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670

notes.title: Developers update 21
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_01.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twentyfirst developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


Thank you for the successful start of the Open Beta! We were able to collect a lot of feedback and we are already in full swing to improve the game. Aside from bugfixes, we are fully focusing on polishing the game up, as it is time to prepare everything for the release next year.

Today, we are going to talk about the new infantry controls. Firstly, we are improving the interface to make it easier for you to select your desired weapon or item. Secondly, as you can see above, we were working on an improved camera, that even allows you to have some rudimentary first person controls!
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_85b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_85b.jpg[/img][/url]

Aside from that, it allows you to have some real indoor fights without nasty camera clipping. Furthermore, we introduced a solution for grenade throwing, that makes it a lot easier to aim at your desired target. Flashbangs will blind you in 3rd person as well.
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_86b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_86b.jpg[/img][/url]

Lastly, each weapon has it's own zoom distance, so ACOG equipped rifles and sniper scopes give you a major advantage on distance!

The infantry controls are shaping up nicely and we are very happy with the quick progress we are making here. Hope you will be too!

The update is due to the end of the week. :cta_emo7:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: Open Beta
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_07.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the Open Beta of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! Actually, we planned to have a soft launch to test everything out with a small group of players, but as it seems, this is already taking off without us doing anything, let alone announce it!


[h1]Major Update[/h1]

We just released the largest and most important update for Call to Arms to date. This massive patch includes tons of improvements, visually and performance wise, as well as plenty of new features to enhance your gameplay experience!

You can find the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/?ctp=3#c215439774871699976]Change-Log here[/url]!


[h1]Some Explanations[/h1]

Firstly, we would like to point out a few differences between the free2play edition and the Call to Arms full version. The free2play version is multiplayer only, does not give you access to Workshop, or LAN and requires you to unlock units via the progression system. Call to Arms full version on the other hand has a complete singleplayer and cooperative campaign available. Those who purchased the game earlier during Early Access paid 10$ less than what the game costs now. If you bought it during a sale, you paid even less. If you purchased the Deluxe Edition or backed the game on our website, then you’ll receive an additional singleplayer campaign and two minor factions for multiplayer, as soon as they are ready for release. Deluxe Edition owners also receive some exclusive in-game items.

Now there might be some of you who say, well, I don’t need all of that, I just bought that game for multiplayer. We understand that, but we also understand that multiplayer can only work if you have enough people to play with. Purchasing a game during Early Access is supporting the development of a game and we support our community by delivering you more and better content for free over a long period of time.

We would also like to point out, that even though the game is available for free to try out, it is still Early Access. That means the game is not complete and you play it at your own risk. If you do not understand or like the concept of Early Access, then please wait until the game is released. Every time we read a review that contains something like “But the game doesn’t look finished and uses stuff from MoW” a kitten dies. :cta_emo9:

To find out more, about the improvements that are in the latest update, check out the latest devupdate:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/646658987730392966


[h1]Season Pass[/h1]

Today we also launch the Season Pass for Call to Arms! If you are happy with the progress of the game and if you like to support the game even more, then you can purchase the Season Pass that contains 3 additional DLC, which will be available [b]after[/b] Early Access. With your help, we can create more factions and content at a faster speed. To reward your support, the Season Pass is 20% off for two weeks! Before you purchase, please check out the description on the store page.

[b]To clarify:[/b] everyone will get the new factions for free in multiplayer. Season Pass owners will get them earlier, while they are still in beta and don’t have to unlock any units. Furthermore, each DLC contains a new singleplayer campaign. Again, there will be no DLC available during Early Access, only Beta access to new factions. This is just another opportunity to support the game, while saving some bucks.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561140


[h1]Steam Market[/h1]

Let’s talk about the biggest of all new features. The in-game market and items.

[b]How does it work?[/b]
Simply play the game with standard settings, singleplayer or multiplayer and you will receive some items here and there. These items are boxes that you can open to receive cool content.

[b]What items are there?[/b]
You can get some XP bonuses to unlock units faster if you play the free2play version. For those who own the full game already, you can save these items until new factions are available, trade them in the Steam market and earn some money, or exchange them into in-game cash. In-game cash can be exchanged into new boxes.

http://steamcommunity.com/market/search?appid=302670

As you can see, already plenty of people are trading in-game items and there are various levels of rarity. The rarer an item is, the more valuable it is.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_78.jpg[/img]

There are also items, that allow you to customize your units. For instance, the squad logo badges and backgrounds. These items can be combined with colors you get and allow you to change the visual appearance of your profile and units. Simply click on your player avatar to customize your squad logo. This logo will be rendered on all your units in-game. If you want to preview it, you can do so by opening the Library.

We will add new items and cool stuff step by step in the future, but these items remain cosmetics or functional features and do not provide any advantages in pvp.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_79.jpg[/img]

There is a lot more we want to talk about. But there is only so much space left on this page.

So stay tuned for more news and cool updates soon! :cta_emo7:

notes.title: Developers update 20
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_06.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twentieth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

It’s been a massive ride lately, as our team has been pushing super hard to improve the game in every aspect!

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
All vehicles have 4 times higher resolution textures now and feature squad logos on them, that you can customize easily by yourself. These logos are synced online, so that each player can be identified in the heat of combat!
Furthermore, we completely reworked the vehicle controls, they are much easier and smoother to use now. Vehicles have realistic acceleration and speed that depends on the terrain you are driving on and we just added vehicle suspension physics to the game! Not only that, but we also improved the vehicle interaction code with physics to finally stop the flipping over of vehicles. The interaction is not perfect yet, but it does the job and will be continuously improved.

Poor pathing has been adding lots of stress to players and we are pleased to say, that most issues have been solved and pathing has been improved dramatically. Still, it’s not perfect, but we will continue to work on this as well!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_76b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_76.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
Graphics have been upgraded tremendously, as well as game performance. Your environment does look a lot better now and gives justice to the 3rd person controls. Expect many visual improvements in the future as well. For now, you will be able to enjoy HD textures and a much better overall visual presentation of the game!

[h1]Infantry Controls[/h1]
Some of you who tried out the open beta patch lately, probably noticed that we introduced 3rd person controls to infantry and we would like to share our plans for it. 3rd person controls will completely exchange all other control styles. As it stands, we develop two games, a RTS and a 3rd person shooter game. This is a lot of work and it is very difficult to accomplish. Adding a third old school control scheme from previous games just makes this task impossible and will heavily impact the overall quality of the game. Therefore, we will no longer work on it or support it. However, we made it easy for modders to enable the old control scheme if they desire.
Infantry controls will be a bit rough at the beginning, so please give us some time to polish them up. We are aware of the current issues and we are working on solutions for it. Just remember, how much the tank controls have been improved since the first iteration.

Our plans are to allow you to switch between squad members, as we believe the 3rd person feature should be mostly a squad based feature, not a primarily single soldier experience. In this regard, we will add specific UI controls to make it easy for you to keep track of your soldier and squad members. Furthermore, we are working on vastly improved infantry controls. You will be able to strafe, sprint and zoom on enemies depending on the weapon you carry with you. An easy way to switch between equipment is also planned. Many criticized the grenade tossing controls and we have plans to improve that as well.
At the end, we will deliver new animations to make the controls look and feel good. Further down the road, we will improve the camera behavior to allow better in door fighting.

Again, please give us some time to figure everything out. The controls are a step by step evolution.

Once infantry controls are done, you can expect new controls for helicopters to arrive!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_77b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_77.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Steam Market[/h1]
Call to Arms is now part of the Steam market and you can earn yourself some awesome in-game items. Some of them are the previously mentioned squad logos. To earn these items, you simply need to play the game and not leave running matches. Those who stay in-game until the match is over, will occasionally get rewarded by supply boxes. These supply boxes can be opened, as they contain various types of items. Got the same item twice? No problem, exchange it into in-game cash and trade it for new supply boxes, or go to the Steam market and sell your item to other players! Play and earn money. Sounds good, doesn’t it?

The late November update (no further delays), will be the biggest and most meaningful update the game has yet to receive and we are very happy how well the game has progressed lately. We hope, you will be as well! :cta_emo10:

It’s been a massive ride lately, as our team has been pushing super hard to improve the game in every aspect!

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
All vehicles have 4 times higher resolution textures now and feature squad logos on them, that you can customize easily by yourself. These logos are synced online, so that each player can be identified in the heat of combat!
Furthermore, we completely reworked the vehicle controls, they are much easier and smoother to use now. Vehicles have realistic acceleration and speed that depends on the terrain you are driving on and we just added vehicle suspension physics to the game! Not only that, but we also improved the vehicle interaction code with physics to finally stop the flipping over of vehicles. The interaction is not perfect yet, but it does the job and will be continuously improved.

Poor pathing has been adding lots of stress to players and we are pleased to say, that most issues have been solved and pathing has been improved dramatically. Still, it’s not perfect, but we will continue to work on this as well!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_76b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_76.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
Graphics have been upgraded tremendously, as well as game performance. Your environment does look a lot better now and gives justice to the 3rd person controls. Expect many visual improvements in the future as well. For now, you will be able to enjoy HD textures and a much better overall visual presentation of the game!

[h1]Infantry Controls[/h1]
Some of you who tried out the open beta patch lately, probably noticed that we introduced 3rd person controls to infantry and we would like to share our plans for it. 3rd person controls will completely exchange all other control styles. As it stands, we develop two games, a RTS and a 3rd person shooter game. This is a lot of work and it is very difficult to accomplish. Adding a third old school control scheme from previous games just makes this task impossible and will heavily impact the overall quality of the game. Therefore, we will no longer work on it or support it. However, we made it easy for modders to enable the old control scheme if they desire.
Infantry controls will be a bit rough at the beginning, so please give us some time to polish them up. We are aware of the current issues and we are working on solutions for it. Just remember, how much the tank controls have been improved since the first iteration.

Our plans are to allow you to switch between squad members, as we believe the 3rd person feature should be mostly a squad based feature, not a primarily single soldier experience. In this regard, we will add specific UI controls to make it easy for you to keep track of your soldier and squad members. Furthermore, we are working on vastly improved infantry controls. You will be able to strafe, sprint and zoom on enemies depending on the weapon you carry with you. An easy way to switch between equipment is also planned. Many criticized the grenade tossing controls and we have plans to improve that as well.
At the end, we will deliver new animations to make the controls look and feel good. Further down the road, we will improve the camera behavior to allow better in door fighting.

Again, please give us some time to figure everything out. The controls are a step by step evolution.

Once infantry controls are done, you can expect new controls for helicopters to arrive!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_77b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_77.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Steam Market[/h1]
Call to Arms is now part of the Steam market and you can earn yourself some awesome in-game items. Some of them are the previously mentioned squad logos. To earn these items, you simply need to play the game and not leave running matches. Those who stay in-game until the match is over, will occasionally get rewarded by supply boxes. These supply boxes can be opened, as they contain various types of items. Got the same item twice? No problem, exchange it into in-game cash and trade it for new supply boxes, or go to the Steam market and sell your item to other players! Play and earn money. Sounds good, doesn’t it?

The late November update (no further delays), will be the biggest and most meaningful update the game has yet to receive and we are very happy how well the game has progressed lately. We hope, you will be as well! ːcta_emo10ː

notes.title: Developers update 19
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our nineteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

The development of Call to Arms is in full swing and we have many news to share!


In the next update, we will include the long awaited library. You can look up all the stats of every weapon, soldier and vehicle in the main menu and study them carefully before entering the heat of combat!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_74b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_74b.jpg[/img][/url]

We are also upgrading all vehicles to 4k resoluted textures, which is 4 times more detailed than the current ones. Furthermore, we will re-do the infantry skins to fit our latest quality standards. Call to Arms will go through continued evolution and we will continuously make the game look and play better!

In this regard, we also announce the Season Pass coming for Call to Arms. [b](important: [u]no[/u] DLC will be available during Early Access!)[/b] It will include the Minor Factions pack (this one is also included in Deluxe Edition and available to backers), as well as the German and Russian armies. Furthermore you will get access to two new singleplayer and cooperative campaigns upon completion!

[h1]Season Pass[/h1]
[list][*]Season Pass owners will get Early Access to new factions
[*]Everyone will receive access to the new factions upon full completion of each DLC
[*]If you do not own the DLC or Season Pass, you will have to unlock the units via level progression and you will not receive the singleplayer/cooperative campaigns
[*]The Season Pass will possibly include more DLC if the game is successful, Season Pass owners will get them lifelong for free
[/list]


[h1]Monetization[/h1]
We announced that Call to Arms will have a free2play version. Let's clarify how we intend to monetize the game:
[list][*]Free2play version will not have mods, no singleplayer and will have unit progression enabled
[*]If you buy the game or corresponding faction DLC, you will not have to unlock any units and therefore save time
[*]There will be [u]no[/u] pay2win elements in Call to Arms
[*]We will add Steam Market items to the game, they will be cosmetic or have convenient features included[/list]


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_75b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_75b.jpg[/img][/url]

Such items will be squad logos, which you can customize and place on all of your units to distinguish them from other players. XP boosts and smilies for the chat will be included too, as well as other neat features! You will earn these items by simply playing the game or trading them in the market.


You can check out the open beta on Steam! :cta_emo7:

notes.title: Developers update 18
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our eighteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Today we are going to announce some exciting changes and plans we have for Call to Arms!

Firstly, we are sticking to our plans to "finish" up the game in October this year. However, we will not move out of Early Access at this stage. What we will do instead, is to polish up the game and release the content we have promised before. This means you will receive the full US campaign, 20 multiplayer maps and two factions with dozens of units and various gamemodes. Furthermore, we will launch a free2play edition of Call to Arms in October that includes the basic multiplayer, but with unit progression and no access to singleplayer or mods. This way, new players can try the game out before purchasing and they will be able to play with people who own the full game as well.

As announced before, we are also working on some Eastern European environment setting and we will expand the game by two minor factions that will be part of the GRM campaign DLC. (This DLC will be included in the Deluxe Edition for free). It will be available a few months after the October free2play release and is one of our measures to increase the longevity of the game.

Our full release is targeted at Q1 2017 with complete voice overs, localizations and new features and fixes. We think we need the extra time to give the game justice and to collect enough feedback from users. But again, we do this mostly to make this game bigger and better than we initially promised. Some new features that are coming soon are:


[h1]Weapon library[/h1]
You will be able to check out all weapons and vehicles, as well as soldiers in the main menu with corresponding stats. This will help you to learn the game and to understands the pros and cons of your equipment. It's also a very nice way to check out on the details each weapon has.

[h1]Market[/h1]
We will include a Steam item market into the game. This way you will be able to collect some free items (for instance in-game chat smilies) by playing the game and some of you might even earn some cash by trading these items in the Steam market. Expect more details to be available soon!

[h1]Choppers[/h1]
Yes, they will be coming in October too. Hopefully we can show them off soon!


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_73b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_73.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developers update 17
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_02.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our seventeenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

We at Digitalmindsoft are celebrating our 10th Anniversary this month!

In the last 10 years many things have changed and we are very grateful for the opportunity to work on a game like Call to Arms. Since the start of Early Access, our on-site Team has doubled in size and we will be moving to a new office early next year to continue our growth strategy. We have been collecting a lot of experience and gathered tons of feedback from our community and the game is getting bigger and better every day. All of this would not have been possible without your help, so thank you!


[h1]In this regard, we also have some amazing things to announce![/h1]

We are currently working on some Eastern European environment setting and we will expand the game by two minor factions that will be part of the GRM campaign DLC. (This DLC will be included in the Deluxe Edition for free) One of the two factions are the Arab government forces that fight against the GRM in the campaign. We are also working on an Eastern European rebellion force that will be a nice fit for to the new scenery. Both factions will make heavy use of the already existing weapons, but each of them comes with unique equipment not available to others.

They will also support the newly introduced alliance feature. The Arab government forces will team up with the US troops, while the Eastern Europeans will join the GRM in multiplayer games.

Furthermore, our artists started to polish the game up and lots of assets have been improved in the last couple of months. Old vehicles will get up to 4 times higher resolution, so that they are rendered with beautiful details even when playing in 3rd person mode. Lots of engine improvements and bug fixes have been done as well. Furthermore, our programmers are working on new features such as helicopters and an in-menu weapons library.

Plenty of new assets and new maps will be available in the 10th anniversary update coming to you next month. Exciting times lay ahead!

notes.title: Developers update 16
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_06.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our sixteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Call to Arms is still progressing very well and we added a good amount of content lately!

[h1]Unit library[/h1]
Next month we will be finishing the basic main menu interface and then we will move on to work on new features. One of it will be the unit and weapon library for your units. You will be able to browse through their stats and compare them with other weapons. This comes in extremely handy, as you can take all the time you need before you jump into a multiplayer match.

[h1]New units[/h1]
In the latest patch, you received two new units, the T-62 and LAV-25A2. They will a big gap in each factions unit rooster and add more variety to online combat. Try them out, they are lots of fun!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_68b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_68.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_69b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_69.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Helicopters[/h1]
Choppers will be coming to some of the multiplayer modes! It will still take some time to implement nice controls for them, but we plan to have them in-game before release. You will be able to choose between differently equipped choppers to help your friendly units on the ground. So stay tuned!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_67b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_67.jpg[/img][/url]


The game is still at 75% off for this week, don't miss that opportunity and get it before the game gets more expensive! :cta_emo10:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670

notes.title: Developers update 15
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_03.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fifteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Call to Arms is progressing very well and we have quite some news for you!

[h1]Alliances[/h1]
One of the biggest new features will be the upcoming multiplayer alliances. In the future, you will be able to play with different factions in the same team. Hosts have the option between:
[list][*]the classic mode of faction vs. faction
[*]alliances that represent factions that fight together in the story-line
[*]free factions in which each player can choose whatever he wants to play with
[/list]

This might not be ground breaking at this point, but it’s an important feature for the future of Call to Arms. After the release of the game, we will be working on new factions that can partner up with the existing ones!

[h1]King of the Hill[/h1]
Thanks to the new code for the alliances feature, you will also be able to play games with more than 2 teams. For instance king of the hill 2v2v2v2. More cool gamemodes will be coming soon to add a nice variation to the game!

[h1]Thermal vision[/h1]
To enhance usability of 3rd person in dense environments, we’ve been working on thermal vision for vehicles. It will make it much easier for you to spot enemies and focus on what’s really important during combat.

[h1]Release date[/h1]
We are scheduling the game for a release in October 2016. Thanks to your support we are able to make this game bigger and better, hence we want to use the time to really polish the game up for a great experience.

Call to Arms has been coming along nicely and we will continue to push the game forward! :cta_emo10:

notes.title: Developers update 14
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_09.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fourteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

It’s been a while since our last patch for Call to Arms and we are happy to tell you the waiting was worth it!

[h1]Medics[/h1]
We finally added the medic unit class! Unlike in previous games, the medic is a specifically trained soldier with a unique ability to revive wounded soldiers. Furthermore, we added a mechanic that only veteran soldiers can be revived. So it takes a little bit of an extra effort to get your soldiers on to the “safe side”. Reviving isn’t instant either, but it takes a couple of seconds depending on how qualified your medic is. After that, your medic and your revived soldier will auto prone to hide from enemy fire. For the first time ever, your medic will also work in competitive multiplayer and you can revive friendly units as well!

[h1]Sounds[/h1]
We’ve been reworking the whole sound environment with a huge amount of high quality stereo sounds and we will continue to polish the sound effects until we are fully satisfied! This time you will enjoy new and realistic reloading sounds, amazing silencer sounds and a huge variety of extremely well recorded environment sounds and much more!

[h1]Weapon damage[/h1]
We introduced a completely new system for weapon damage to reflect real world fire arms even better in the game. Thanks to the idea of our community member Blub0r2k, we are now using a system that uses muzzle velocity and gun calibre size to determine the strength of a weapon.

[h1]Balance[/h1]
The game has become too hardcore and too frustrating at times, hence we have re-balanced the whole small arms fire damage. The damage curve is a lot more straight forward now and the weapon damage is much better balanced to reward taking risk and flanking units, as well as making defending easier against hordes of enemy soldiers. Last Man Standing and Evacuation have been rebalanced as well. A new growing CP system has been introduced to make early game less spammy but more tactical and versatile.

[h1]Ammo trucks[/h1]
New units joined the battlefield as well! Finally both the US and the GRM have basic trucks and ammo trucks in their unit roster to re-supply or to transport units quickly!

[h1]Enhanced 3rd person interface[/h1]
We added an improved 3rd person interface that shows you your tank orientation and damaged parts. A compass helps you to communicate and mark enemy units for your teammates. A crew display helps you to understand the effects of losing crew members to enemy fire and a new weapon selection system allows you to quickly switch weapons by just pressing the designated number!

[h1]Main menu interface[/h1]
Of course our biggest project, the new main menu interface is progressing as well! LAN mode is re-enabled for local games and single skirmish matches. We’ve also been working on many improvements and bug fixes. Very important for anyone looking to level up: the XP display has been re-added to the session screen. Furthermore we have been working on the party system. Once completed, you will be able to invite your friends to chat in private and to join/host games together.

[h1]Engine improvements[/h1]
We are currently reworking effects like Ambient Occlusion and Sun Rays to enhance performance and graphics fidelity. This also includes new weather effects, like day and night cycle, as well as fancy new effects.



[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_65b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_65.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_66b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_66.jpg[/img][/url]

As you see, we have been doing many improvements to the game lately and we will continue to push the pace at which these improvements are done. Expect more cool stuff soon!

The patch will be available later this weekend. ːcta_emo1ː

notes.title: Developers update 13
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our thirteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

[h1]Beta[/h1]
Call to Arms will soon move to Beta status, this means that we are half-way through the Early Access phase and all owners of the standard edition will receive the first 5 singleplayer missions to play. It also means, that once we are in beta, we will increase the price of the game by 5$. Hence if you plan to get the game you shouldn't wait for too long!

Soon after the Beta has been launched, we will update the Roadmap, as we decided to take some additional time to listen and to implement player feedback in the game. Overall, the game has changed a lot from the early days after launch and we are excited to work on new and cool features to enhance the game even more!

Let's talk about what we have done since the last developers update.


[h1]New tracer behaviour and bullet physics[/h1]
Bullets can now bounce off from a lot more materials than before, this also includes ground surfaces. In the next update, tracers will also behave realistically. Instead of appearing randomly, they will follow a realistic ammo belt pattern. Furthermore, tracers are disabled for most weapons like in real life. However, if you use direct control, tracers are enabled for your weapon and you can mark enemy units for your allies!

[h1]Armored Warfare[/h1]
We also added a new gamemode, specifically designed for vehicle combat. We improved ATGM controls as they play a very important role in that gamemode. APCs can now capture strategic points and in the next update they will be able supply other vehicles with ammunition. To make re-supplying easier, supply trucks are planned to follow next. [h1]Gun behaviour[/h1]
In 3rd person, gun ranges are unlimited and penetration physics represent this very well now. We also changed muzzle speeds of tank guns and small arms to enhance realism. This wasn't possible before, but now you have different muzzle speeds and shell behaviours depending on what kind of ammo you load and fire. For instance, T80-U's can now shoot ATGMs through their main gun.

Additionally, we are starting to improve the in-game GUI step by step, as well as the 3rd person interface.

New high quality vehicles sounds have been added lately and as a next step we will introduce the in-game music. Completely new voice acting is planned too, but it will be done closer to release, as the game needs to be feature ready for any kind of localization work.

notes.title: Developers update 11
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our eleventh developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Civilians[/h1]
As you can see below, we added new humanskins for civilians, they will play a minor role in the campaign. So be careful what you are aiming for!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_43b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_43.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]New buildings[/h1]
Our artists are working on a variety of new buildings for different settings. Expect huge hotels and office buildings as well as slum huts. Each map and mission will have its own unique and distinct feeling attached to it.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_44b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_44.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New units[/h1]
We were working on new units such as the Humvee with a TOW and a technical using a ZPU AA-gun. They add faction variety and help us to balance gameplay between factions. Our next move will be to start working on faction specific trucks for transport and re-supplying.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_45b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_45.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_46b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_46.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New main menu interface[/h1]
Finally, we began to work on the new main menu interface. It is a huge task as we will design it from the ground up. This means that updates may not come in as frequent as before, at least until the interface is fully functional. We will show you some work in progress screenshots soon, so stay tuned!

See you on the battlefield! ːcta_emo1ː

notes.title: Developers update 10
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_03.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our tenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

https://youtu.be/P_r-Zs_VOrI

notes.title: Developers update 9
notes.content:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_10.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our ninth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c523898291501172400]Change-Log[/url] of the latest patch!


[h1]New multiplayer map[/h1]
The community voted for a new multiplayer map: 4v4 Military base. This map is expanding the existing pool by a unique setting and different gameplay. We are definitely excited to see it in the next patch!

[h1]New gamemode[/h1]
We are currently working on a new multiplayer gamemode called King of the Hill. It’s a 1v1v1v1 battle with a single center flag. Everyone is up against each other and only the best player can win in this mode. You will have to develop unique strategies to overcome your enemies and you have to time your actions carefully as you will not receive any payback for lost troops.

[h1]Small arms & improvements[/h1]
We have been adding a few new small arms to the game, including proper tank machine guns for GRM. We have also added shields to technicals to provide some protection to frontal fire, however they still offer weak protection if they are getting flanked. Additionally we added much better LODing for trees. It will allow us to render vegetation on long distance without hurting performance too much.

[h1]New water[/h1]
Aside from Screen Space Ambient Occlusion we are also working on new water technology! Water will blend in softly and take depth into consideration. It will also simulate the distortion of objects below the water surface. It will be quite a step visually and new water plants will add extra diversity to maritime landscapes, even a shark will pass by once in a while!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_42.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developers update 8
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our eighth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c523897023728040834]Change-Log[/url] of the latest patch!


[h1]New vehicles[/h1]
The community voted for the M2A3 Bradley and BMP-2 and today they joined the battlefield in Call to Arms! Both are equipped with deadly weaponry. For the first time you are able to use TOWs that add a new level of depth to tank combat.

[h1]New gamemode[/h1]
We have been working on a new gamemode for Call to Arms which is called Last Man Standing. Contrary to Domination, you do not receive any payback for lost units during the battle. This makes the gamemode a lot more tactical and strategic as keeping your men alive is your key priority. To regain some resources, you can capture supply boxes on the map. These supply boxes provide great incentive to push into enemy territory. You win the match if you reach the score limit by destroying enemy troops, or if your enemy runs out of troops, or if you capture their base flag.

[h1]New graphic options[/h1]
Finally we introduced a simple way to select your graphic options with presets ranging from minimal to ultra. These settings are optimized and heavily recommended. Furthermore, we re-introduced the no shadow option.

[h1]Multiplayer optimization[/h1]
We polished the level of detail settings and introduced special settings for multiplayer. This allow us to enhance the graphics fidelity in singleplayer without hurting the performance in multiplayer!

notes.title: Developers update 7
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_06.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our seventh developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]New vehicles[/h1]
APCs are joining the battle in Call to Arms! Their special ability is to re-supply friendly units nearby, if necessary they will also provide the required fire power to support advancing infantry. The update is already live, so check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c527273452875779614]change-log![/url]

[h1]3rd person controls[/h1]
We also improved 3rd person controls, now it's as simple as pressing your middle mouse button and the AI will take over the gunner position and do the shooting while you focus on driving!

[h1]Soft particles[/h1]
Usually particles clip with surrounding objects. They look flat and unatural. Soft particles on the other side use scene depth information to render particles accurately by taking surrounding objects into consideration. The result are much better for effects of any kind!

[h1]Glow with HDR[/h1]
We also added glow with HDR support to the engine. They are used to highlight light materials such as lamps, fire, explosions and so on. If applied to existing effects, you will see much better results. Just compare the first screenshot (no soft particles, no glow with HDR) with the second screenshot!


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_39b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_39.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Night vision[/h1]
We added night vision environments for intense night combat experiences. The game does not only turn green, but light sources are much stronger including weapon tracers. You can enjoy it in the video below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CK3QX4TAAuM&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Developers update 6
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our sixth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Depth of field[/h1]
The game engine supports depth of field now. It's a great feature to enhance the visuals of cutscenes and long distance views. From now on, the engine is able to collect scene depth information and that allows us to work on new features such as soft particles, ambient occlusion and much better water. So expect many cool visual upgrades soon!

[h1]Unicode[/h1]
Finally, we added Unicode support to the engine! That means all non-latin chat symbols and nicknames will be displayed correctly. If you are a modder, make sure your localization files are all converted to UTF-8 without BOM.


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_33b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_33.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_34b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_34.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Squad leaders[/h1]
We have added new skins for infantry squad leaders. Now they differ from the regular soldiers and you can easily distinguish them from other squad members. Our next step will be to deliver different regular soldier faces to enhance visual variety on the battlefield.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_35b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_35.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Chatwheel[/h1]
We added a chatwheel for notifications (hold “n”) and for chat messages (hold “z” or “shift + z”)
These messages allow you to quickly communicate with your team members and mark important locations or units. It helps to break language barriers and in the final version of Call to Arms, the chatwheel text notifications will also be automatically translated in the language of the receiver.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_36.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developers update 5
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fifth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Game Updates[/h1]
We’ve been doing a lot of tweaks to the game and added neat features for you to discover. Elite soldiers carry flash lights at night and the looks of them also differ between the two factions. This makes it easier for you to distinguish between friend and foe!

Finally we moved to DX11 and we are currently bug hunting any remaining issues. Next step will be to optimize the performance and to move the game to 64bit. This will be another big and time consuming task, but we are moving in closer.

We’ve also started to add the first seasonal skins for soldiers. They will carry appropriate uniforms when fighting in woodlands, snow or desert! Most importantly, a tad of gore has been added too.. oh yeah and backers will receive their keys later today!

notes.title: Developers update 4
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_07.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fourth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Upcoming Release[/h1]
So we are finally ready to provide some details about the upcoming release of the game. Currently we are planning send out keys to backers within the next 2 weeks. The game will hit Early Access by the end of July or August. The final dates will be announced once we collected the first feedback from our backers. As much as we want you guys to start playing the game, we want to make sure your experience is as good as it can be.

The game will be available in a standard version and a Deluxe Edition. We are excited to announce that we will allow you to try out the work in progress missions if you own the Deluxe Edition. Once the missions are finalized, they will be available to everyone who purchased the game. The game comes with multiplayer bots to enjoy the game at the pace you choose. We will start off with infantry combat and we will introduce vehicles step by step to multiplayer. On top of it, you will receive the map/mission editor out of the box together with Steam Workshop support.


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_21b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_21.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_22b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_22.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Domination Gamemode[/h1]
We are currently working on an objective based gamemode. Each team has to capture strategic positions placed on the map, the amount depends on the player count. The team with more flags receives scores. The team that reaches the score limit first wins. The strategic points provide cover to your troops and most importantly they will allow you to re-supply. This adds another element to the game, as you can destroy the ammo caches with Composite C-4 or mine them with Claymores if you want to prevent enemies from taking advantage of it. ːhonorː

[h1]New Shaders & Fortifications[/h1]
We are stepping up the visuals with new shader technology for Call to Arms. One of these shaders is called light scattering to simulate a beautiful sunrise. notes.title: Developers update 1
notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our first developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Dynamic Shellholes[/h1]
The game features dynamic shellholes that depend on the strength of the explosion and the ground below. To create an outstanding volumetric effect we added displacement maps to smaller shellholes. This parallax effect delivers an amazing result and immersion. In case of bigger explosions, the terrain will be deformed and new three-dimensional cover will be created.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_07b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_07.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_08b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_08.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Instanced grass[/h1]
We have been reworking the previous grass rendering system completely. The new instanced grass supports high resolution textures, as well as normal maps and speculars. New types of grass can be easily created and thanks to new random placement modifiers, it will look a lot more natural than before. notes.content:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our first developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Dynamic Shellholes[/h1]
The game features dynamic shellholes that depend on the strength of the explosion and the ground below. To create an outstanding volumetric effect we added displacement maps to smaller shellholes. This parallax effect delivers an amazing result and immersion. In case of bigger explosions, the terrain will be deformed and new three-dimensional cover will be created.
